jobs.title: Project Manager - Customer Success
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about driving digital transformation that directly enhances how customers experience and succeed with industry-leading products? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.

As our new Project Manager - Digital Customer Success, you will be spearheading digital customer success initiatives that bridge technology and user experience, ensuring our digital platforms and tools deliver measurable value to customers across the water technology landscape. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

What you will be doing?

As a key part of the Digital Customer Success team, you'll create impact by Leading cross-functional digital projects that elevate customer engagement, streamline digital touchpoints, and accelerate adoption of Grundfos's digital solutions worldwide in the space of remote monitoring, sensors and telemetry products.

Your main responsibilities include:

Plan, execute, and deliver digital customer success projects on time, within scope, and on budget
Collaborate with product owners, developers, and business stakeholders to define project roadmaps and success metrics
Drive adoption of digital platforms and tools by coordinating customer onboarding and engagement initiatives
Manage project risks, dependencies, and escalations while maintaining transparent communication with senior leadership
Analyse customer usage data and feedback to identify improvement opportunities and inform project priorities
Facilitate cross-functional workshops to align teams on deliverables and timelines

What makes you a great fit?

Above all, you are a results-oriented project management professional with a strong digital mindset, proven stakeholder management skills, and a genuine passion for improving customer outcomes through technology. We would also imagine that you have:

2+ years of project management experience in digital, technical, or customer-facing technology environments
Proven track record delivering complex technical projects using Agile, Scrum, or hybrid methodologies
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels
Experience with remote monitoring systems, sensors, and telemetry products is a bonus

It is a plus if you also have:

PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification
Experience in B2B or industrial/manufacturing digital transformation initiatives
Familiarity with data analytics or service management techniques

Why you will love working here

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.
Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.
Access to on-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.

We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds.

Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com

jobs.title: Assistant Planner
jobs.description:
End date:
3- 6 months to start; multiple openings are opening in the planning department, and this person will be supporting the increased workload

Hours:
8:00 am -5:00 pm

Location:
Emeryville, CA (Hybrid: Tues - Thurs in office)

Pay:
$36.23/hr

Report to: The Assistant Planner will report to the Sr. Inventory Planner.

What We Offer:
Hunter Hamilton offers comprehensive benefits packages (medical, dental, vision, long and short-term disability, 401k, etc.). We strive to deliver genuine support throughout the duration of the recruiting process, through the length of the assignment, and beyond!

About Our Organization:
Come and support our long-standing partner in the food / grocery industry. This company has been in business for over 75 years. They promote a positive and fun culture and strive to give back to local communities.

Job Scope

You will be responsible for managing the distribution of merchandise to support company plan. Extremely “hands-on”, you will need to be able to make quick decisions, manage key warehouse and planning relationships and provide inventory information for your assigned departments.

You will be responsible for assisting the Planning Team in ensuring proper product inventories at all stores to facilitate optimum code life, minimize seasonal markdowns and maximize turns. You will recommend and execute changes as needed to ensure profitability and productivity.

About You

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and/or relevant experience
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Can successfully manage multiple tasks simultaneously
Can make solid decisions quickly based on limited information
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form
Intermediate experience with Excel preferred
Ability to work independently, as well as with a team
Concern for achieving positive outcomes and growing the business; willing to get involved in all aspects of the process
Ability to be creative, resourceful and take ownership over your categories

Work Responsibilities

Understand and execute appropriate distribution of products to stores to maximize store turns and profitability
Implement the company’s "Treasure Hunt" philosophy and merchandise assortment strategy through effective execution of product allocation to stores
Analyze store level data to identify chain/region/store level trends and recommend/implement changes and action as appropriate
Execute category/sub-class trends regionally and identify specific merchandise needs through knowledge of regional and climatic characteristics
Execute seasonal distributions in accordance with direction provided by planning & purchasing teams
Responsible for managing those items approaching expiration in the warehouse
Responsible for managing items on the Aged report (slower moving items - identify and collaborate with planner, action as appropriate)
Responsible for building, in partnership with set crew, an appropriate inventory mix to support new store openings
Manage store distribution groups based on location, volume, size, demographics and sales trends
Own cross-functional communication regarding product sales, inventory position, and distributions for all stores
Build, develop, and maintain effective and productive working relationships within cross-functional team (District Sales Managers, Planning Department, Purchasing Department, Stores, Distribution Center, etc.)
Participate in cross-functional meetings, contributing on distribution strategies
Review MTO items in-stock position with planners/buyers - weekly
Demonstrate logical analysis and problem-solving skills through organization and prioritization
Demonstrate superior listening, written, and oral communication skills
Present analytics and reports to various levels of management
Assists buyers with updates on potential inventory or code date issues on all products
Execute profitable entrance and exit strategies as determined by planning, with merchandising for new, seasonal and replacement programs
Visit stores and warehouses as necessary
Perform other duties as assigned

The base pay range listed reflects what we reasonably expect to offer for this role. Actual pay may vary based on location, experience, and performance. Depending on the position, benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement and savings plans; paid holidays and time off; supplemental insurance; and additional wellness or incentive programs.

jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

1. About Our Client:

The organization operates within the Energy & Resources sector, providing geospatial services and solutions primarily for projects in Mining, Hydropower & Dams, Power Delivery, and Oil & Gas. It addresses complex challenges by delivering spatial insights that help internal teams and external clients meet their business objectives. The company supports projects across North America and beyond, leveraging a specialized team of GIS professionals.

2. About the Opportunity:

The GIS Analyst
plays a critical role in delivering geospatial strategies and solutions that support key projects across multiple energy-related sectors. This position contributes by collaborating with project teams and stakeholders to design and implement effective GIS approaches that drive project success. The role involves managing small to mid-sized projects and supporting larger initiatives, providing technical leadership, and innovating how spatial data is utilized. The position is location-flexible with a preference for candidates near specific U.S. hub offices.

3. Responsibilities:

Collaborate with project teams to design and implement geospatial strategies aligned with client goals
Lead GIS efforts on small to mid-sized projects, managing scope, schedule, and budget
Contribute technically to large, multi-year projects
Innovate methods for spatial data collection, management, visualization, and sharing
Create clear and compelling cartographic products, both static and interactive
Develop and manage GIS solutions using Esri applications such as Dashboards, Experience Builder, Hub Sites, StoryMaps, Field Maps, and Survey123
Ensure adherence to the organization’s GIS standards and best practices
Mentor GIS team members at various experience levels
Maintain high-quality assurance standards for deliverables
Stay engaged with the GIS team and geospatial community to track emerging technologies and trends
Adapt to changes in project scope, timelines, and budget, including occasional non-traditional hours
Maintain safety standards in all working environments

4. Requirements:

Strong experience with desktop GIS platforms, especially ArcGIS Pro
Proficiency in ArcGIS Online and mobile GIS platforms
Ability to manage project scope, schedule, and budget
Experience creating both static and interactive cartographic products
Knowledge of Esri GIS applications and tools relevant to solution development
Skills in mentoring and guiding team members
Commitment to quality assurance and standards compliance
Flexibility to adjust to evolving project requirements and work schedules

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:

Pay ranges are provided in compliance with pay transparency laws where required
Final compensation depends on education, qualifications, experience, and location
Certain roles are eligible for bonuses
Part-time compensation is pro-rated based on agreed working hours

Paid time off

jobs.description:

1. About Our Client:

The organization operates in the data security industry, focusing on addressing the challenge of securing data in the cloud era. It provides a cloud-native data security platform designed to enable businesses to protect their data, support agile collaboration, and pursue new business opportunities. Serving security teams at leading global enterprises, including a growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, the organization is positioned at the forefront of emerging data security needs in cybersecurity.

2. About the Opportunity:

The Customer Success Engineer
will play a pivotal role in enhancing customer satisfaction and maximizing the value customers derive from the data security platform. This position is responsible for driving adoption, resolving technical challenges, and fostering long-term relationships to ensure customers achieve their business and technology goals. The role involves direct client engagement, including travel, to support onboarding, training, and ongoing success initiatives.

3. Responsibilities:

Act as the primary technical expert on the data security platform.
Establish trusted advisor relationships with customers at all organizational levels.
Lead customer onboarding and training to drive platform adoption.
Understand customer needs and design tailored solutions aligning with their business outcomes.
Ensure customers maximize their return on investment through sustained platform engagement.
Identify and resolve obstacles impacting customer success, collaborating with internal teams.
Advocate for customer feedback to influence product development and roadmap.
Support customer education using self-paced training resources.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues affecting customers.
Monitor and report on customer health and usage metrics.
Develop joint success plans with customers.
Document and share best practices internally and externally.
Mentor team members and assist in their professional growth.
Participate in hiring processes to onboard new talent.
Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews to assess progress and identify improvement areas.

4. Requirements:

Associate degree or equivalent experience required; Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field preferred.
12 years of experience with strong project management skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.
Proven track record in driving revenue growth, customer satisfaction, feature adoption, and retention.
Experience collaborating with development teams.
Proficiency in SQL, scripting languages (e.g., Python), and cloud environments.
At least 3 years hands-on experience with data and cloud technologies including databases, cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, and permissions.
Familiarity with APIs, web services, and programming or scripting languages.
Preferred expertise in DLP, Data Privacy/Protection, DSPM/CSPM, SIEM, or vulnerability management.
Previous technical customer-facing role experience in a software company.
Demonstrated ability to manage customer relationships through onboarding, renewals, and expansions.
Self-motivated and proactive team player focused on customer loyalty.
Strong interpersonal skills for building and maintaining strategic relationships.

Compensation Range: $140,000-$160,000.
This range represents total compensation and may include incentives, equity, or benefits as applicable.

The organization operates in the data resilience and AI security space, addressing challenges in data understanding, security, and resilience to support the safe scaling of AI technologies. serves as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of strategic enterprise and commercial accounts.
